_note: Kitchens published on the PUBLIC site under /webviewer/ (npm run webviewer:sync). Everything published is downloadable by any visitor, so the showcase is curated: "decors" = the only manufacturer decors copied (ids from the source catalog_products.json; display fields only, textures re-encoded at <= 512 px); "locked" = up to 12 premium previews shown with a lock in the viewer's demo mode (name, maker, colour and a 96 px thumbnail only - nothing to apply); "cta" = per-language link of the demo card's "Start your project"; "home" = per-language link of "Back to main website" on the standalone viewer page; "logo" = the official logo shown there; "libraryUrl" = the site's library API: the sync writes the full library (display fields + 96 px thumbnails) to the git-ignored private/webviewer/, and the demo browses it as locked previews (markets, manufacturers, search). An entry without "decors" is refused unless it says "publishFullCatalog": true (its whole catalog would become public). "popular" = the "Frequently used" finishes by kind (solid / wood / stone): a demo decor listed there applies, any other is shown locked (display fields + a 96 px thumbnail). "curatedOptions": false drops the base kitchen's own generic swatches, so only real decors are offered. The first entry is the site's default kitchen.
